message: インプット・アウトプット

name: Ria
message: 「T-Tonight's demon was pretty tough, wasn't it?」

name: Ria
message: 「Is everyone okay? No injuries? Don't you dare try to tough it out!」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm unharmed. Because you put yourself on the line to protect me, Big Sister.\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't worry about it. We're teammates, so it's only natural!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm fine. Alive and kicking.」

name: Synn
message: 「Me too.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama is always rock hard and ready to go.」

name: Misa
message: 「D-Dirty!! So you really are just after our transformation scenes, aren't you!?」

name: Synn
message: 「You've got the wrong idea. I don't want to see things like that.」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha--!? What do you mean by 'things like that'!」

name: Ria
message: 「Now, now, that's enough out of both of you. And Paqy, you knew this would happen, so don't tease them... Bad!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kuhaa~... G-Good stuff. Getting scolded by Ria might just become a habit.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz, zzz, zzz~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh boy, Lolo fell asleep.」

name: Ria
message: 「She must be tired from the fight.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hic, snff... Waaah, Ms. Treasurer ate my ankoro mochi~」

name: Ria
message: 「Nanaka... Bad!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I didn't eat it, Lolo's just talking in her sleep! And hey, what's she making me do in her dreams anyway?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, sneaking a bite of chocolate cake would be one thing, but Nanaka eating ankoro mochi? No way.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Right, right!」

name: Misa
message: 「...R-Really?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gasp!? N-No, I didn't!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz, zzz, zzz~, mumble-mumble.」

name: Synn
message: 「She's fast asleep standing up... Let's drop Lolotte off at her house before we call it a night.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes. Though I suspect her bodyguard will come pick her up before we even need to lend a hand.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, you mean Asobinin Tooyama?」

name: Riesling
message: 「It is Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Dwah!? W-When did you get behind me!?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Lady Nanaka... your tactics have a certain habit, allowing me to read your moves by the third step every time.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「R-Really? Guess I'll try changing up how I fight next time.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz, zzz, zzz~」

name: Riesling
message: 「My lady, here is some chestnut melon bread.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz, zzz... sway, sway, sway~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「L-Lolo-chan is getting lured away hook, line, and sinker...」

name: Ria
message: 「S-She'd get kidnapped so easily...」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you walk all the way here, Riesling-san?」

name: Riesling
message: 「No, I came by car.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Uwah!? It's parked right behind us! I didn't hear a single sound!」
It goes into stealth mode sometimes...

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz, zzz, zzz~. Munch, munch, nom, nom.」
Riesling-san carefully carries Lolotte and lays her down in the back seat.

name: Riesling
message: 「Now then, please excuse me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Please take good care of Lolotte.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Yes, please leave my lady's escort for the night to me, her butler, Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz, zzz, zzz~. Wave, wave, wave.」
Riesling-san takes the sleeping Lolotte's hand and makes her wave bye-bye to us.

name: Misa
message: 「What incredible acceleration. They're out of sight already.」

name: Ria
message: 「Fast, right? My big sister has a car just like that too.」

name: Ria
message: 「She takes me out for drives sometimes, and--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sounds good. Once we beat the Demon Lord, let's ask Helena to take us all on a drive!」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm all for it. Being here with everyone like this is fun now, sure, but once we defeat the Demon Lord, it's bound to be even more fun.」

name: Misa
message: 「When that day comes, I'll make the boxed lunches.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then I'll go buy some sweets for dessert!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And Roro can be in charge of eating!」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, if you just stand there quietly, I'm going to put you on luggage duty and lunchbox-washing duty, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I'm fine with that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aww, Misa, that's so mean!」

name: Ria
message: 「Misa-chan... bad girl!」

name: Misa
message: 「N-No, that's not it! Big Sister, please don't misunderstand either!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, Sakura-kun, fight back a little! It's no contest like this!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Weird... Are you tired, Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Maybe...」

name: Ria
message: 「All right, that's it for today's activities!」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, Misa-chan, Nanaka-chan, be careful going home. Remember, Crusaders aren't off the clock until you're safely back at your house!」

name: Ria
message: 「Also, I really think you should pass on going for a drive with my big sister?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「After letting us plan it all out this far?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Because nine times out of ten, it turns into a car chase with the cops.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's dark.」

name: Paqy
message: 「No kidding. How far do you think it is from the bluffs all the way down here?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... I walked all the way here? No wonder it's already the middle of the night.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Wandering around taking the long way... Got something on your mind?」

name: Synn
message: 「Something like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「I got tired and spaced out. To think I ended up in a place like this without even noticing.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nah, you noticed alright, didn't you, Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Yeah.」

name: Synn
message: 「Because this is a special place where I had dinner with Misa, after all.」
I sit down on the bench.
Tonight there's no dinner, and Misa isn't sitting here either. Chilled by the night air, the bench is freezing cold.

name: Synn
message: 「Hiding my true identity from everyone... from Misa is painful.」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you notice, Paqy? The change in Misa.」

name: Synn
message: 「Lately, Misa has been showing me her absolute best smiles.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ain't that a good thing? There's no need to mope around in the middle of the night like this, y'know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though I'm the Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「If she found out that the King of the Demons she fights day and night was actually me, right beside her all along... Misa might never smile at me again...」

name: Synn
message: 「If it was going to hurt this much, I should have just confessed from the very beginning.」

name: Synn
message: 「If I had, maybe we could have built a relationship between me as the Demon Lord and Misa as a human.」

name: Paqy
message: 「'What ifs' about the past are off-limits, y'hear? Brooding over that stuff won't get you anywhere.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Look, geniuses and idiots alike always make the best choice they can for themselves in the moment, right? Regretting that is totally barking up the wrong tree.」

name: Synn
message: 「I know that. But I'm so scared of losing my relationship with Misa that I can't just accept it logically.」

name: Synn
message: 「I think I'm probably in love with Misa.」

name: Paqy
message: 「'Probably'?! Don't screw around, Synn-sama, you don't get it at all!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm in love with Misa!」

name: Synn
message: 「And the more drawn I am to Misa, the more I come to hate myself for being the Demon Lord.」

name: Synn
message: 「I wish I weren't the Demon Lord...」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's a pretty luxurious problem to have, y'know? Normally, humans worry 'cause they're lacking something.」

name: Paqy
message: 「But you're human while also holding the power of the Demon Lord, Synn-sama!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That power ain't exactly gonna get in your way, right? Bottom line, it all comes down to the Demon Lord's mindset.」

name: Paqy
message: 「First off, do you even know what a Demon Lord is, Synn-sama?」

name: Synn
message: 「Umm, as for Demon Lords besides me, I only know Da-h-huh?!」

name: Synn
message: 「I love my dad, okay? I respect him as family, and the whole reason I had such a fun childhood is thanks to him.」

name: Paqy
message: 「See? Told ya. You just have way too bad an image of Demon Lords, Synn-sama.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Humans come in all sorts, right? Demons are the exact same way.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sure, there were some guys among 'em who tried to rule the world, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh right, you've served generations of Demon Lords, haven't you, Paqy?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Damn right! But the real Demon Lords I know ain't small-timers who get obsessed with petty ambitions like world conquest!」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's slowly coming back to me. You're just like the very first Demon Lord, Synn-sama.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Man, the Re-Crea back then was a real handful, y'know?」

name: Paqy
message: 「The Demon World, the Human World, Heaven... It was a massive upheaval so bad it nearly blew away all of creation across the three realms.」

name: Synn
message: 「S-So what happened to the first Demon Lord?!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, wait! I wanna know what the first Demon Lord did back then! How did things turn out in the end?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, about that...」

name: Paqy
message: 「I don't remember.」

name: Synn
message: 「P-Paqy...」

name: Paqy
message: 「There was way too much to keep track of, so I forgot. Living a long life just to serve the Demon Lord sure is a tricky business.」

name: Synn
message: 「Haaah~」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm? Ahahaha, my sigh is pure white. It looks just like Misa's breath.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Good grief, whether you're worrying or laughing, it always comes back to Hisa in the end, doesn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「So then... is what the Demon Lord doing right? Or is it wrong? Does that mean I'm the one who has to decide?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I still don't have the answer, but I feel a lot better.」

name: Synn
message: 「And thank you, Paqy. For calling me Synn-sama instead of Maou-sama while you were listening to my worries.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You dumbass! If you've got time to stare at the great me, take a good hard look at yourself, Maou-sama!」

name: Synn
message: 「Before that, it's okay if I look at you for just a second, right? Your body soaked up the night fog from the docks and got all sloshy and bloated?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gyaaah?! If Ria-chan sees me with a figure like this, she's gonna hate my guts!」

name: Synn
message: 「Umm, to get you back to normal, I wring you out like a rag--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Put me on the 8-hour hand-wash and dry-clean cycle!!」

name: Synn
message: 「...I-I have to pull an all-nighter?」
